svg.title: NetForge
svg.desc: Byte transformation & binary triage. Chain byte transformations and inspect binary data through encoding, hashing, XOR, entropy, strings extraction, PE inspection, and framing. Rust · Memory-mapped input · Reusable buffers. Parallel analysis · Property tests · Fuzzing
